purpose: Describe how a human or an AI agent can discover, retrieve and verify this static laboratory.

human_access.accessibility: Semantic HTML, keyboard-visible focus, skip links, text alternatives and a no-JavaScript reading path.

availability.schedule: On every main branch update and every six hours.
checks: HTTPS response status 200 for human and machine entrypoints.
Expected content type and non-empty response body.
Canonical links, titles, descriptions, language and basic image alternatives on HTML pages.
Valid JSON, synchronized payment manifests and required endpoint references.
No broken internal href or src path in the public HTML.
availability.success_definition: A check passes only when required routes return expected content and the canonical machine-readable documents agree.

consultation.reason: Aggregate browser measurement is enabled, but no numeric report has been published. GitHub Pages still does not expose request logs for direct agent requests.

human_measurement.purpose: Aggregate browser page views and visits for this hostname.
human_measurement.scope: Browser measurement only; it does not prove a unique human, attention or understanding.
human_measurement.personal_data: The provider states that Web Analytics does not collect or use visitors' personal data.
human_measurement.retention: This site stores no copy of dashboard records; provider retention follows the provider's current service policy.

agent_requests.reason: Static GitHub Pages does not expose request logs through this site.

consultation.future_measurement: Add access-log measurement only after a log-capable edge or host and the bot-separation rules are documented on the public policy page.
